# Global settings

## Clear work space and set global variables
```{r global-options}
# Clear memory
rm(list=ls()) # Clear environmental variables
gc() # memory garbage removal
# set global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=12, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)

```

## Load libaries 
```{r load-packages}
if(!require("pacman", quietly=T)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(osfr,tinytex,tidyverse,keyring,knitr,readxl,data.table,colorspace, lpSolve,irr,here,lme4,broom,psych,zoo,units,ggdist,cowplot,ggcorrplot,dplyr, patchwork, cowplot, ggpmisc, forcats, pwr, ggpmisc, simstudy, explore, car,VIM,mice,flextable,here, remotes,magrittr,reshape2,descr,table1,tableone,gmodels,xtable,lavaan,corrplot,caret,corrgram,Hmisc,polycor,lavaan,kableExtra,DiagrammeR,grid,Gmisc,epitools)
```


## Set up local tempfolder for raw and processed data files
```{r local-tempfolder}
# Get the path to the session's temporary directory
session_temp_dir <- tempdir()

# Define paths for the specific temporary subdirectories
raw_data_dir <- file.path(session_temp_dir, "raw_data")
processed_data_dir <- file.path(session_temp_dir, "processed_data")

# Create the 'raw_data' subdirectory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(raw_data_dir)) {
  dir.create(raw_data_dir)
}

# Create the 'processed_data' subdirectory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(processed_data_dir)) {
  dir.create(processed_data_dir)
}

 
```

# Download Zotero_tag_export_long.csv 
```{r get-processed-data-osf, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE, results='hide'}

osf_retrieve_node(processed_data_node_id) %>%
  osf_ls_files(pattern = "Complete_SynthesisTable.csv") %>%
   osf_download(path = raw_data_dir, conflicts="overwrite",progress=TRUE)
```

## Load Zotero tag export file into R data frame
```{r list-csv-files}

csv_file <- list.files(path = raw_data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(csv_file) == 0) {
  stop("Error: No csv file found in the specified directory.")
}



# standard pathname
csv_file[1] <- file.path(dirname(csv_file[1]), basename(csv_file[1]))
if (!file.exists(csv_file[1])) {
  stop("File does not exist. Check the path.")
}

print(csv_file)
```

# Select first CSV file

```{r load-csv-file}
# Read the Markdown file
Complete_SynthesisTable <- read.csv(csv_file[1], encoding = "UTF-8")

# Check if the file is empty
if (length(Complete_SynthesisTable) == 0) {
  stop("Error: The csv file is empty.")
}
```

```{r count number of rows}

data.frame(total_rows = nrow(Complete_SynthesisTable))

```


```{r count context}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Count occurrences of higher_education, business_context, and both
context_counts <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(
    context_category = case_when(
      grepl("higher_education", context) & grepl("business_context", context) ~ "both",
      grepl("higher_education", context) ~ "higher_education",
      grepl("business_context", context) ~ "business_context",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(context_category)

# Print the table
print(context_counts)

# Make a bar plot
ggplot(context_counts, aes(x = context_category, y = n, fill = context_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrences of Context Categories",
    x = "Context Category",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r check both}

both_titles <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(
    context_category = case_when(
      grepl("higher_education", context) & grepl("business_context", context) ~ "both",
      grepl("higher_education", context) ~ "higher_education",
      grepl("business_context", context) ~ "business_context",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(context_category == "both") %>%
  select(title)

print(both_titles)

```



```{r count methods}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

methods_counts <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(
    method_category = case_when(
      grepl("method_mixed", methods) ~ "method_mixed",
      grepl("method_quantitative", methods) & grepl("method_qualitative", methods) ~ "method_mixed",
      grepl("method_qualitative_interpreted", methods) ~ "method_qualitative",
      grepl("method_qualitative", methods) ~ "method_qualitative",
      grepl("method_quantitative", methods) ~ "method_quantitative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_   # instead of "other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(method_category)) %>%   # remove NAs
  count(method_category)

# Print the table
print(methods_counts)

# Bar plot (ordered by count, descending)
ggplot(methods_counts, aes(x = reorder(method_category, -n), y = n, fill = method_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrences of Method Categories",
    x = "Method Category",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

mixed_titles <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(
    method_category = case_when(
      grepl("method_mixed", methods) ~ "method_mixed",
      grepl("method_quantitative", methods) & grepl("method_qualitative", methods) ~ "method_mixed",
      grepl("method_qualitative_interpreted", methods) ~ "method_qualitative",
      grepl("method_qualitative", methods) ~ "method_qualitative",
      grepl("method_quantitative", methods) ~ "method_quantitative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(method_category == "method_mixed") %>%
  select(title)

print(mixed_titles)
```

```{r count disciplines}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# Define the list of disciplines to count
disciplines_to_count <- c(
  "discipline_accountant",
  "discipline_arts",
  "discipline_economics",
  "discipline_entrepreneurship",
  "discipline_ethics",
  "discipline_interdisciplinairy",
  "discipline_innovation",
  "discipline_leadership",
  "discipline_management",
  "discipline_marketing",
  "discipline_sustainability",
  "discipline_strategy",
  "discipline_changemanagement",
  "discipline_supplychain",
  "discipline_HR",
  "discipline_organisational", 
  "discipline_ICT"
)

# Expand the dataframe so each discipline per row
disciplines_counts <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(disciplines_split = str_extract_all(disciplines, paste(disciplines_to_count, collapse="|"))) %>%
  unnest(disciplines_split) %>%
  distinct() %>%  # remove duplicates
  group_by(row_id = row_number()) %>%  # temporary row id
  mutate(
    drop_management = "discipline_management" %in% disciplines_split & length(disciplines_split) > 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!(disciplines_split == "discipline_management" & drop_management)) %>%
  count(disciplines_split, name = "n")

# Print counts
print(disciplines_counts)

# Plot
ggplot(disciplines_counts, aes(x = reorder(disciplines_split, -n), y = n, fill = disciplines_split)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrences of Disciplines",
    x = "Discipline",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r count locations}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define all location keywords
locations_to_count <- c(
  "location_europe",
  "location_nordamerica",
  "location_asia",
  "location_southamerica",
  "location_online",
  "location_australia",
  "location_europe_secundary",
  "location_nordamerica_secundary",
  "location_southamerica_secundary",
  "location_africa"
)

# Expand the dataframe so each location per row and recode secundary
locations_counts <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(locations_split = str_extract_all(locations, paste(locations_to_count, collapse="|"))) %>%
  unnest(locations_split) %>%
  mutate(
    location_clean = case_when(
      locations_split == "location_nordamerica_secundary" ~ "location_nordamerica",
      locations_split == "location_southamerica_secundary" ~ "location_southamerica",
      locations_split == "location_europe_secundary" ~ "location_europe",
      TRUE ~ locations_split
    )
  ) %>%
  count(location_clean, name = "n")

# Print counts
print(locations_counts)

# Plot
ggplot(locations_counts, aes(x = reorder(location_clean, -n), y = n, fill = location_clean)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrences of Locations",
    x = "Location",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r integration}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define integration keywords
integration_to_count <- c("artsrelated", "artsbased", "artsinformed", "intergration_unclear")

# Detect integration types per row and collapse into a single category
integration_counts <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(
    integration_found = str_extract_all(intergration, paste(integration_to_count, collapse="|")),
    integration_category = case_when(
      lengths(integration_found) == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      lengths(integration_found) == 1 ~ sapply(integration_found, `[`, 1),
      lengths(integration_found) > 1 ~ "both"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(integration_category)) %>%
  count(integration_category, name = "n")

# Print counts
print(integration_counts)

# Plot
ggplot(integration_counts, aes(x = reorder(integration_category, -n), y = n, fill = integration_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Occurrences of Integration Types",
    x = "Integration Type",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

both_titles_integration <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%

    integration_category = case_when(
      lengths(integration_found) == 0 ~ NA_character_,
      lengths(integration_found) == 1 ~ sapply(integration_found, `[`, 1),
      lengths(integration_found) > 1 ~ "both"
    )
  ) %>%

print(both_titles_integration)
```


```{r arts_form}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# All tokens to count (including form_music)
forms_all <- c(
  "artform", "form_diverse", "form_multimedia", 
  "form_narrative", "form_theatre", "form_visual", "form_music"
)

# Simple pattern to find any of the tokens
pattern <- str_c(forms_all, collapse = "|")

# Count each form once per row, even if multiple appear
arts_forms_counts_all <- Complete_SynthesisTable %>%
  mutate(
    arts_forms   = coalesce(arts_forms, ""),                  # handle NA
    row_id       = row_number(),
    forms_found  = str_extract_all(arts_forms, pattern)       # list of matches per row
  ) %>%
  mutate(forms_found = lapply(forms_found, unique)) %>%       # don't double-count same form within a row
  unnest(forms_found) %>%                                     # one row per (row_id, form)
  count(forms_found, name = "n") %>%                          # total rows where each form appears
  arrange(desc(n))

print(arts_forms_counts_all)

```
